Sounds interesting - could you clarify what you mean by:

- Asset management and the treasury


What assets? 
Do you mean diversify the treasury?

- General market performance for EDG. 


The market judges Edgeware on its ability to focus on a credible story that connects, what do you think a review of the market performance will tell us other than we haven't settled on a credible story that connects? 

I only state this now because we've already gone through one round of naval-gazing around market price which proved distracting and led us all to arguments. 

Keen to listen in to the thinking so far!
